title: Christmas Salad
description:
This winter salad is just downright pretty. Who could not want to eat these colors? Best part is that this is the
simplest salad. It’s contains only a few key ingredients. Candied walnuts, pomegranates, cranberries, goat cheese
and an incredible balsamic fig dressing that is a great go-to dressing for all salads. It’s so good. AND it’s also
healthy. Perfect way to balance all these Christmas sweets.
ingredients: 6 cups mixed greens I used baby kale and spinach

To make the dressing, whisk the olive oil, balsamic vinegar, fig preserves and salt until combined. Just
before serving, drizzle the dressing over the salad and gently toss. Enjoy!
